text: {"lessons":["I will not treat a short run of account gains or losses as proof that a trade was sound; I will assess decisions against the evidence and my long-term goal of beating the market.","I will avoid selling or buying simply to react to recent price moves, and will make each trade only when my investment case has materially changed or a better opportunity is clear.","I will keep position sizes and cash reserves prudent, especially when adding to stocks that have already fallen or selling holdings at a loss."]}
